column1: # EU fragrance allergens that must be LABELLED on cosmetics above 0.001 % (leave-on) / 0.01 % (rinse-off).
# Read 2026-09-27 from the official EUR-Lex texts: every CAS number in the Annex of Regulation (EU)
# 2023/1545 (replaced + added entries) and in entries 67-92 of Annex III of Regulation (EC) 1223/2009
# (the original 26; benzyl alcohol is entry 45/68 there). EU legislative texts: reuse permitted.
# NOT tracked: later bans (Lilial and Lyral are now Annex II, prohibited). A listing is a labelling duty,
# not a safety verdict. Natural extracts (oakmoss, essential oils) are listed by their own CAS numbers.
